exposure: Atrial switch procedure for transposition of the great arteries (TGA)
cohort: The study included 162 pregnant women with a systemic right ventricle (sRV) after atrial switch procedure for TGA or CCTGA, with a mean age of 28.8 years.
finding: The majority of women with a systemic right ventricle tolerated pregnancy well with favorable maternal and fetal outcomes, despite heart failure and arrhythmias being the most common major adverse cardiac events.
